description: This is a Java source file defining the DriverFactory class responsible for creating, managing, and quitting Selenium WebDriver instances based on configuration. It supports Chrome and Firefox browsers in both headless and headed modes, utilizing WebDriverManager for driver setup and ThreadLocal for parallel test execution.

classes.name: com.orangehrm.driver.DriverFactory
classes.description: Factory class for initializing and managing WebDriver instances with support for Chrome and Firefox browsers, configured via ConfigManager, and supporting parallel execution with ThreadLocal.

methods.name: initDriver
methods.description: Initializes WebDriver based on browser configuration, sets timeouts, maximizes window, and stores driver in ThreadLocal.

methods.name: getDriver
methods.description: Retrieves the WebDriver instance for the current thread, throws IllegalStateException if not initialized.

methods.name: quitDriver
methods.description: Quits the WebDriver instance for the current thread and cleans up ThreadLocal storage.

methods.name: createDriver
methods.description: Dispatches driver creation to specific browser driver methods based on input.

methods.name: createChromeDriver
methods.description: Creates and configures a Chrome WebDriver with optional headless mode and stability flags.

methods.name: createFirefoxDriver
methods.description: Creates and configures a Firefox WebDriver with optional headless mode.
